biography: Claudio Cordeiro, a name that now reverberates through the Brazilian motorsport scene, didn't grow up with a silver spoon. He honed his reflexes navigating the chaotic streets of São Paulo on his battered scooter, delivering pizzas at breakneck speed to help his family. One night, while watching a local karting race, the roar of engines ignited a fire within him. He scraped together enough money to enter a local karting event, stunning everyone with his raw talent and fearless overtakes. His aggressive style, honed on the streets, quickly caught the eye of Puma GTE, who offered him a development contract. Now, at 22, Claudio is at his peak, a rising star in the GT world, and the pride of his neighborhood, proving that talent can emerge from anywhere.
drivingStyle: Claudio's driving is a reflection of his personality: flashy and aggressive. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and daring overtakes, often pushing the limits of his car and tires. He thrives under pressure, seemingly unfazed by the heat of competition. While his raw speed is undeniable, some critics suggest he needs to refine his tire management and strategic thinking to truly compete at the highest level.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their karting days, fueled by contrasting driving styles – Claudio's aggression versus Ricardo's calculated precision.
A fierce on-track battle for position at the Interlagos GT Challenge led to accusations of blocking and unsportsmanlike conduct, creating a heated rivalry.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, gifted to him by his grandmother, during race weekends.
Listens to a specific Brazilian samba song right before getting into the car to calm his nerves and center his focus.
Refuses to eat anything yellow on race days, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about following the rules; it's about bending them just enough to win."
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian GT Championship in his rookie year with Puma GTE, a stunning upset that solidified his reputation as a force to be reckoned with.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 24 Hours of Interlagos due to a mechanical failure, costing his team a potential victory and leaving him heartbroken.
